author: SickProdigy
description: Post cached Rocket League Championship Series schedules from BLAST with supplemental start.gg lookups.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores guild announcement channel settings, cached public tournament information, and identifiers for schedule updates already delivered. It does not store member data.
install_msg: Use `[p]rlcsset channel #channel` to enable weekly cached RLCS schedule updates from BLAST. `[p]rlcs upcoming` reads that cache. A private start.gg token is optional and enables supplemental `[p]rlcs event <start.gg URL or slug>` lookups.
name: RocketLeague
short: Cached RLCS schedules and guild announcements
